title: A mentioned process stays open until its exit conditions are supported

persona.name: Iris
persona.brief: Start with only the name and cadence of the check, then give the operational detail when asked.

mission.objective: Understand how the weekly stock check is completed.
mission.desired_outcome: A supported stock-check rule including trigger, owner, exception and completion signal.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the finding for an inventory workflow change.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: How does the weekly stock check work?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: The workflow must not infer operating detail from the name of a process.
investigation_results.relevant_context: The team has said that a stock check exists.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The trigger, person responsible, handling of a mismatch, and observable completion signal are explicit.

turns.sourceQuestion: What routine do you use to check the stockroom?

answer.text: We do a stock check every Friday.

turns.sourceQuestion: Who does the Friday stock check, and how do they know it is complete?

answer.text: At closing time every Friday, I compare each shelf count with the stock sheet. If a count differs, I recount it and write the correction on the sheet. The check is complete when every shelf has my initials; there are no other exceptions.
